Title: Lines per level
Description: Require 10 cleared lines to advance one level.

Title: Single line clear
Description: On lock with exactly one full row, remove that row and shift rows below it up by one.

Title: Double line clear
Description: On lock with exactly two full rows, clear both in a single step.

Title: Triple line clear
Description: On lock with exactly three full rows, clear all three in a single step.

Title: Maximum three rows per lock
Description: Never clear more than three rows from a single lock (no four-line clears in this variant).

Title: Non-contiguous clears preserve gaps
Description: Remove only filled rows and settle remaining blocks upward, preserving partial-row gaps.

Title: No false clear
Description: Do not clear any row that contains an empty cell.

Title: Collision integrity invariant
Description: Never allow an active-figure cell to overlap an occupied cell or exit left/right/top bounds.

Title: Keyboard bindings for must-have actions
Description: Bind move (arrows), soft rise (Up), hard rise (Space), rotate (X/Z/Ctrl), Hold (C/Shift), Pause (Esc/P), Restart (R).

Title: Deterministic repeat and simultaneous keys
Description: Handle key repeat without missed/doubled input and resolve simultaneous keys deterministically, keeping collision invariants.

Title: Suppress browser default gestures
Description: While playing, suppress default behaviors so arrows/Space do not scroll and touch gestures do not zoom.

Title: Input spam safe
Description: On many inputs within one frame, do not crash, enter an illegal state, or double-move; keep collision invariants.

Title: Concurrent rotate+move+rise deterministic
Description: Resolve simultaneous rotate/move/rise deterministically without overlap or escaping bounds.

Title: Hard rise into full column
Description: On hard rise into a full/near-full column, lock correctly at the bottom entry (may trigger game over) without crashing.

Title: localStorage unavailable degrades gracefully
Description: If localStorage is unavailable/quota-exceeded/private, degrade persistence gracefully and stay playable.

Title: Ghost figure matches landing
Description: Display a ghost figure marking the exact hard-rise landing cells.

Title: Playfield dimensions
Description: Provide a playfield 15 cells wide and 35 cells high.

Title: Cell state
Description: Represent each cell as empty or filled with a specific figure color/type.

Title: Level increases every 10 lines
Description: Increase the level by one for every 10 lines cleared since the last level-up.

Title: Start spawns first figure and starts rise
Description: On Start, spawn first figure at bottom-center and start the rise timer.

Title: Pause stops rise and timer
Description: On pause, stop the active figure rising and stop the rise timer.

Title: Pause ignores gameplay input
Description: While paused, ignore all input except Resume.

Title: Resume restores identical state
Description: On resume, continue from the identical state that existed before pausing.

Title: Restart resets state
Description: On Restart after game over, reset board, score, level, and lines and begin a fresh game.

Title: Tab blur auto-pause without runaway loops
Description: On tab blur/background, auto-pause or continue deterministically with exactly one loop and no runaway timers on refocus.

Title: Lock on landing and spawn next
Description: When the figure can no longer rise, lock it into the board and spawn a new figure.

Title: Bounded lock delay
Description: Allow movement/rotation during a bounded lock delay (~500 ms) without indefinite stalling.

Title: Horizontal move by one column
Description: On Left/Right, move the figure exactly one column if target cells are empty and in bounds.

Title: Blocked horizontal move rejected
Description: Reject a Left/Right move that crosses a boundary or overlaps a locked cell, leaving figure unchanged.

Title: Automatic rise ascent
Description: Move the active figure up one cell automatically every rise tick.

Title: Soft rise accelerates ascent
Description: While Soft Rise is held, accelerate ascent beyond the normal rise rate.

Title: Hard rise locks instantly
Description: On Hard Rise, move the figure to its topmost landing position and lock it there.

Title: Inverted gravity — figures rise
Description: Move active figures upward (inverse gravity), locking against the top wall or underside of the stack.

Title: Block-out ends game
Description: When a new figure immediately collides at the bottom spawn area, set status gameover and stop the rise loop.

Title: Game-over screen with score and restart
Description: On game over, display a game-over screen showing the final score and a Restart action.

Title: No board mutation after game over
Description: While game over, ignore gameplay input that would mutate the board.

Title: No spawn after game over until restart
Description: While game over, do not spawn a new figure until the user restarts.

Title: Exactly four figures exist
Description: Provide exactly four figures I, P, L, C with the specified geometry and no others.

Title: Figure colors
Description: Render each figure in its assigned color (I=#30b5c5, P=#c00000, L=#ED6D00, C=#a0d183).

Title: Three cells per figure
Description: Compose each figure of exactly three cells.

Title: Spawn position centered at bottom
Description: On spawn, place figure at bottom, horizontally centered via x=floor(fieldWidth/2)-floor(pieceWidth/2), standard orientation.

Title: Rotate 90 degrees about pivot
Description: On rotate, rotate 90 degrees in the requested direction about the standard pivot.

Title: Wall kicks
Description: On a colliding rotation, apply the first valid kick-table offset that yields a non-colliding position.

Title: Impossible rotation rejected
Description: If rotation collides with no valid kick, reject it and leave the figure unchanged.

Title: Score monotonic and non-negative
Description: Keep the score monotonically non-decreasing and never negative.

Title: Line-clear scoring scale
Description: Award 100xL / 300xL / 500xL for 1/2/3 lines cleared at level L.

Title: Lines counter increments exactly
Description: Increase the lines-cleared counter by exactly the number of rows cleared on a lock.

Title: Soft/hard rise points
Description: Award 1 point per cell via soft rise and 2 points per cell via hard rise.

Title: High score persists across reloads
Description: Persist the high score (localStorage or analog) so it survives a page reload.

Title: 4-bag randomizer
Description: Generate spawn order with a 4-bag randomizer so each bag of four has no duplicate or starved figure.

Title: Next preview matches spawn
Description: Display a Next preview whose shown figure matches the actual next spawned figure.

Title: Hold swap once per figure
Description: On Hold, swap active with held figure, at most once per figure until it locks.

Title: Static HTTPS hosting
Description: Run over plain HTTPS with no server-side runtime dependency (static-hosting compatible).

Title: HUD shows and updates score/level/lines
Description: Always display current score, level, and lines and update them immediately on change.

Title: Side panel content
Description: Present a side panel with score, level, lines, Next preview, New Game/Restart, and a Game Over indicator.
